annotation.title_clean: 农业农村部办公厅 国家发展改革委办公厅 财政部办公厅 国家粮食和物资储备局办公室关于实施好2025年农业机械报废更新补贴政策的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice on Implementing Well the 2025 Agricultural Machinery Scrapping and Replacement Subsidy Policy
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 农业农村部办公厅; 国家发展改革委办公厅; 财政部办公厅; 国家粮食和物资储备局办公室
annotation.summary_en: Chinese ministerial notice implementing the 2025 agricultural machinery scrapping and replacement subsidy. It expands eligible machinery (including plant-protection drones, BeiDou-assisted driving systems and field monitoring terminals), raises subsidy ceilings, directs use of ultra-long special treasury bonds, and strengthens fraud supervision.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds rice throwing transplanters, field monitoring terminals, plant-protection drones, grain dryers, color sorters and flour mills to subsidy scope
Provinces may select up to 12 machinery categories, raised from 6
Subsidy rates raised up to 50% for some machines; cotton picker cap raised from 60,000 to 80,000 yuan
Funded by ultra-long special treasury bonds with faster payout processes
Measures against subsidy fraud; policy valid 1 Jan–31 Dec 2025, with reporting by 10 Jan 2026
